summary: The five Lean declarations match their stated arithmetic interfaces. The saved-output axiom auditor passed its baseline and rejected ten targeted mutations. After central scheduling, all three R15 trees replayed successfully, with three corruption controls rejected. No revision is required by these checks. No fresh Lean compilation or clean dependency rebuild was performed; geometric premises and the imported H27 theorem remain separate obligations. Both supplied hashes match.

The observed Lean axiom audit verifies the five arithmetic roots under the existing dependency cache. Neither establishes the ordinary geometric reductions or independently re-proves H27.
findings.disposition: Retain the manuscript distinction between these assurance layers; the tested corruption controls support only their specified failure modes.

The hub roots retain ordered deficits, Y+3t<=8, Y+t>=1+b+c and either strict pair bounds or all three equality guards. The support roots retain60<=I with2I+14n<=285, or4I<=225. checks.method: Compared source/object/compile-receipt/log/auditor/runtime hashes with R15ScalarClosure.axiom-audit.json. Executed audit_r15_scalar.py main against isolated temporary copies, updating log hashes for parser-specific mutations.
checks.observation: All six commitments matched. Baseline accepted exactly five roots, each reporting propext and Quot.sound. Ten controls were rejected: missing root, duplicate root, unknown root, sorryAx, unexpected output, failed compile, unstable-source flag, changed source, changed object and mismatched log. Parser controls reached the parser rather than merely failing a stale log hash. Original source, object, receipt, log and auditor commitments still matched afterward. This tests auditing of the saved compilation output, not a fresh Lean build or dependency-cache reconstruction.

checks.scope: Proof-tree replay soundness and geometric boundary
checks.method: Inspected replay_r15_rho6_tree.py check/visit, including candidate reconstruction, scalar pruning, colour witnesses and reverse-order branch coverage, against R15-rho6-finite-closure.md.
checks.observation: The checker fixes target15, rho cap6, minimum-used-degree3 and all120 root-avoiding triples. Inductively, child pools exclude candidates incompatible with the newest selected member and an earlier actual member; two seed members cannot form a sunflower with a root-avoiding candidate because their intersection contains the root. Every colour pair is checked for an actual sunflower witness. Children cover every candidate outside a prefix containing too few colour classes, while missing/reused/cyclic/orphan nodes and solutions are rejected. The finite checker assumes the already-proved support/root/minimum-degree reductions rather than claiming to derive them.
